public.text: Reserve and contingency mechanisms are recommended but not linked to service criticality, recovery needs, or national budgeting processes.
public.suggestedRevision: Require financial-resilience planning based on component criticality, including minimum operating reserves, continuity funding, supplier-failure contingencies, emergency procurement authority, and transition funding for replacement or migration.
